Subject: Staged evidence lanes for renewal + PO release latch

Hi Satpal,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As discussed, we want to set up a standing procurement pattern so Acme can ramp committed capacity while procurement completes its internal checks. To reduce friction we propose a staged evidence + PO release approach (summary below).

Why this model: procurement at Acme prefers to gate PO releases on discrete evidence bundles rather than a single monolithic package. Splitting into lanes lets you accept capacity earlier and spreads procurement approvals across familiar checkpoints.

Proposed staging (high level):
- Lane 1 (PO tranche 1): Basic security artifacts (SOC 2 summary, standard DPA), SOW v3 sign-off. Target release: PO issued on approval.
- Lane 2 (PO tranche 2): Operational evidence (patching cadence, retention policy, audit-log sample). Target release: after lane 1 accepted + evidence upload.
- Lane 3 (final capacity unlock): Performance SLAs, rollout plan, billing schedule.

PO Latch mechanism (how we intend to cooperate):
1) Redwood uploads an evidence bundle to the shared Drive and notifies Procurement Ops.
2) Acme procurement validates Lane 1 items; on acceptance they release PO tranche 1.
3) Redwood provides lane 2 evidence within agreed SLA (7 business days), Procurement releases tranche 2, etc.

Ask: please confirm that Acme procurement is willing to accept this staged-lane model and the contact we should route lane notifications to (Procurement Ops contact or a delegated reviewer). If yes, I’ll send a short mutual action plan with owners and dates.

Attachments referenced: acme_evidence_bundle_v2.pdf (evidence index), redwood_sow_draft_v3.docx (SOW w/ revised term).

Regards,
Marcus Lin

Marcus —

Thanks for laying this out clearly. Procurement is open to a staged lane approach but needs explicit acceptance criteria for each lane. A few notes from our side:

- Procurement will require a signed SOW (we can accept a redline; please include final term dates).
- Lane 1 must include SOC 2 Type II report (summary + control owner contact) and a completed DPA (we have a standard we push into DocuSign).
- Lane 2 should include: data retention table, sample audit log (anonymized), and our access control matrix mapping.
- Lane 3 will require performance runbook and billing cadence.

Timeline: we can validate Lane 1 within 3 business days of receiving the bundle (assuming everything is present). After acceptance we will issue a PO draft for tranche 1; legal may need an additional 2–3 business days for the SOW redline.

Procurement reviewer: please route uploads to procure.ops@acmecloud.com and CC Satpal. If you can include a short mutual action plan with owners and dates we’ll accept that as the single source of truth.

I’ll also flag that our procurement team sometimes enforces a final review window for any contract changes within 7 days of renewal date, so the earlier we lock lane 1 the better.

Thanks,
Satpal
Procurement Manager
AcmeCloud
